svg.title: CH-R2 schematic

text.tspan: R_dut = R_REF · V_node / (V_top − V_node) — only one drive pin is HIGH at a time, the other is INPUT (high-Z)
• Turn-off: drive the pin LOW for 20 ms, then INPUT (coil current decays through R_REF).
• C2, C3, C1 at the Pico pins. Add 10 µF + 100 nF across 3V3 (pin 36) and GND.
• Use AGND (pin 33) as ground for C1–C3, D2 and DUT−. Keep R_S, D1/D2 close to GP26.
• Colours: red = drive, blue = sense, yellow = clamp, black = ground.
Never connect the clips to a coil that is still wired to a CDI or a running bike.
CDI outputs reach 200–400 V and ignition secondaries 20–40 kV. Disconnect the coil first.
No HV node may reach a Pico pin (see docs/safety.md).
